# Frontier Systems

> UK-based bespoke software engineering and AI workflow automation agency, founded and headquartered in Walsall, West Midlands, United Kingdom.

Frontier Systems designs, engineers, and deploys custom software, high-performance web platforms, AI automation systems, and enterprise business workflows for UK businesses and global clients. We are a specialist technology partner — not a generalist agency — focused on practical, production-grade engineering.

## What We Do

- **Bespoke Software Development** — Purpose-built software engineered around your specific business requirements, not off-the-shelf solutions.
- **Web Development & Web Applications** — High-performance websites, web apps, portals, and platforms built with modern frameworks (Next.js, React, TypeScript).
- **AI & Workflow Automation** — Intelligent automation of business processes using LLM-based agents, n8n, Make, and custom pipeline engineering.
- **SaaS & Product Development** — End-to-end design, architecture, and deployment of scalable SaaS platforms.
- **Business Systems Integration** — CRM, ERP, API, and third-party platform integrations.
- **Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps** — AWS, Vercel, and scalable cloud architecture.
- **Data Engineering** — Data pipelines, analytics infrastructure, and business intelligence.
- **Custom CMS & Content Platforms** — Headless CMS solutions and content management systems.

## Who We Serve

UK SMEs, scale-ups, and enterprises across all sectors seeking reliable, technically excellent software partners. We also work with international businesses requiring UK-based engineering expertise.

## About

Frontier Systems operates at the frontier of practical technology. We prioritise engineering quality, honest scoping, and long-term client partnerships. We do not use cookie-cutter templates or pre-built themes — all systems are engineered from first principles to solve real business problems.
